classes.name: AppCont_Function
classes.summary: Class describing a continuous 3d and/or function f(u). This class must be provided by the user to use the approximation algorithm FittingCurve.

instanceMethods.name: GetNumberOfPoints
instanceMethods.signature: (theNbPnt: number, theNbPnt2d: number): { theNbPnt: number; theNbPnt2d: number }
instanceMethods.comment:
Get number of 3d and 2d points returned by "Value" and "D1" functions.
@returns A result object with fields:
- `theNbPnt`: updated value from the call.
- `theNbPnt2d`: updated value from the call.

instanceMethods.name: GetNbOf3dPoints
instanceMethods.comment: Get number of 3d points returned by "Value" and "D1" functions.

instanceMethods.name: GetNbOf2dPoints
instanceMethods.comment: Get number of 2d points returned by "Value" and "D1" functions.

instanceMethods.comment: Returns the first parameter of the function.
